a_state_loss = laplace_rate+k_release_A+k_ads_B_after_A*b_concentration
b_state_loss = laplace_rate+k_release_B+k_ads_A_after_B*a_concentration
ab_state_loss = laplace_rate+k_release_A+k_release_B+k_surface_reaction
ab_binding_factor = (k_ads_B_after_A*b_concentration*k_ads_A_empty*a_concentration/a_state_loss+k_ads_A_after_B*a_concentration*k_ads_B_empty*b_concentration/b_state_loss)/(ab_state_loss-k_ads_B_after_A*b_concentration*k_release_B/a_state_loss-k_ads_A_after_B*a_concentration*k_release_A/b_state_loss)
a_binding_factor = (k_ads_A_empty*a_concentration+k_release_B*ab_binding_factor)/a_state_loss
b_binding_factor = (k_ads_B_empty*b_concentration+k_release_A*ab_binding_factor)/b_state_loss
surface_product_factor = k_surface_reaction*ab_binding_factor/(laplace_rate+k_product_release)
empty_cell_weight = 1/(1+a_binding_factor+b_binding_factor+ab_binding_factor+surface_product_factor)
a_occupied_weight = a_binding_factor*empty_cell_weight
b_occupied_weight = b_binding_factor*empty_cell_weight
ab_occupied_weight = ab_binding_factor*empty_cell_weight
surface_product_weight = surface_product_factor*empty_cell_weight
response = k_product_release*surface_product_weight
